english.meaning: to cheat someone out of money
english.note: This meaning is less certain: it was read from a few recorded conversations.

exampleSentences.english: Maybe someone swindled the money, or—or stole some.
exampleSentences.traditional: 所謂扼咗錢喇，或者，或者俾人偷咗啲錢喇。
exampleSentences.jyutping: so2 wai6 aak1 zo2 cin2 laa1 waak6 ze2 waak6 ze2 bei2 jan4 tau1 zo2 di1 cin2 laa1

exampleSentences.english: Maybe you’ve never lost money or been cheated before. Tell us what happened.
exampleSentences.traditional: 即係可能因為唔見過錢或者俾人扼過錢喇，不如講講哩個經過喇。
